title: The UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 2.26.16.26, UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration…
description: A vulnerability in the UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin for WordPress before versions 2.26.16.26 and 1.26.16 allows users with Subscriber roles to inject data into their own user meta. This data can be rewritten into a live PHP object when an administrator performs a search and replace or migration restore, which WordPress later instantiates. The vulnerability does not include a gadget chain in WordPress core or the plugin itself, so further impact depends on other installed classes.
